Still Reason-only; queue not persisted. Still Reason-only, options not re-applied on session/resume (provider.rs:349-353), queue not persisted, sessions row stores no workspace/agent/model/effort. Still Reason-only, options not re-applied on session/resume, queue not persisted. chat.revert-checkpoint.why: #371: resetReasonChat restores through checkpoint_exists/checkpoint_restore, truncates the transcript, and ChatSaver's diffForSave deletes the dropped turns from session_messages. Reloaded turns keep their chatId:uuid turn ids, so checkpoints are found after a restart. The Reason Session is still not rewound (ACP cannot drop turns), so the agent remembers the deleted turns. Re-read at a0139339: Unchanged: resetReasonChat (reasonChat.ts:269-276) restores via checkpoint_exists/checkpoint_restore and truncates the saved transcript; the Reason Session is not rewound or re-seeded. Re-read at 1e73a260: Moved partial -> implemented for the Reason chat (#387). resetReasonChat (reasonChat.ts:312-326) restores the checkpoint, truncates the transcript, clears the stored Session id and calls ChatSaver.rewind, which sets sessions.claude_session_id = NULL and records resume_session_at in the same transaction (chat_messages.rs, chat_store_commands.rs rewind_to). The next prompt opens a new Session with the chat's options and attaches the kept conversation as 'Earlier conversation.md' (rewind.ts:48). Limits: text-only re-seed (no tool output, truncated past 200k chars) instead of resuming at the message; a quick quit before the debounced DB write can restore the old Session id; Claude Code/Codex checkpointing waits on those runners. Re-read at f6c05d78: Moved implemented -> partial. The Reason chat is unchanged (resetReasonChat restores the checkpoint, truncates, rewinds and re-seeds). #360 makes Codex a user-selectable chat agent with no checkpoints: Reset chat and the turn changes footer are hidden for Codex (WorkspaceView.tsx:326,:328) and codex_chat.rs never calls turn_checkpoint::around_turn, while Conductor checkpoints every turn whatever the agent (ledger ws.checkpoints). Codex edits made between Reason turns land inside the next Reason checkpoint, so a Reason reset silently undoes them. Earlier limits stand: text-only re-seed, quit-before-save window, Claude Code not mounted. Re-read at 8b92f8fc: Unchanged. #396 moves the reset into the agent-agnostic chatRuntime.ts (reset(), chatRuntime.ts) behind a ChatBackend seam; the body is line-for-line the old resetReasonChat (restoreCheckpoint, truncateAfterTurn, drop the stored session id, ChatSaver.rewind) and reasonChat.ts re-exports it as resetReasonChat. Codex (codexChat.ts) does not use the runtime yet and still has no checkpoints, so the partial verdict stands.
chat.revert-checkpoint.obligation: Wrap each codex_prompt turn in around_turn with stable turn ids; enable Reset chat and the turn changes footer for Codex; on reset start a new Codex thread re-seeded with the kept conversation (or thread/rollback if REA shows Conductor uses it); persist the truncation through ChatSaver; then the same for Claude Code.

diff.comments-to-chat.why: #344: control.ts offers 'Add all comments to chat' in the PR header when changes are requested and comments are pending; PrControl calls review.addAllToChat. It is still toChat: formatForAgent text pasted through chat.insert into whichever chat is showing, then diff_comments_mark_sent; no comment_id attachment; toolbar still reads 'Add N comments to chat'. Bug: hasPendingComments counts PR-level and empty-body comments that pendingForAgent excludes, so the header button can appear and do nothing. Re-read at a0139339: Moved partial -> implemented: toChat attaches one markdown attachment per comment carrying commentId (ReviewComments.tsx:360, comments.ts:166-226), deduplicated by comment id (chatAttachment.ts addAttachment); useWorkspaceChatAttach routes them to the workspace chat even while a review chat shows (chatAttachment.ts:57, WorkspaceView.tsx:479); toolbar reads 'Add all comments to chat'. The #344 header count/send mismatch is fixed (comments.ts:154 vs :160 differ only on empty bodies, which diff_comment_add rejects). Remaining: commentId is not stored with the sent message (PromptAttachment has name/text only, chat/reason.ts:84); narrow race where markSent runs before the workspace composer mounts and a workspace switch clears the queue (ReviewComments.tsx:360-361, chatAttachment.ts:59). Re-read at 1e73a260: Unchanged; ComposerAttachment extends TextAttachment, dedupe by commentId still works (chatAttachment.ts:45-50). Re-read at 145d959: Moved implemented -> partial. The empty-body mismatch is not fixed: diff_comment_add rejects empty bodies, but GitHub sync stores bodies unfiltered (review_comments.rs:479, :516), and hasPendingComments (comments.ts:154) still lacks pendingForAgent's body.length > 0 (comments.ts:160), so the PR header 'Add all comments to chat' can show and send nothing. The reference's ready_for_review and queued states are also absent (evidence/diff/comments-to-chat.md:49-57, :138-140): the per-comment toggle never reads 'Remove from chat' or 'Queued', and removing a chip does not reset the comment. Re-read at f6c05d78: Unchanged verdict; one gap fixed. #389: hasPendingComments and pendingForAgent now share isPendingForAgent including body.length > 0 (comments.ts:154-167) over the same list (ReviewComments.tsx:358,:539), so 'Add all comments to chat' no longer shows for empty-body GitHub comments. Still open: no ready_for_review/queued states, so no 'Remove from chat'/'Queued' toggle and removing a chip doesn't reset the comment; commentId not stored with the sent message; on a Codex chat attachments are inlined as fenced text (codexChat.ts:116-117), losing commentId too.
diff.comments-to-chat.obligation: Add ready_for_review and queued states with the Add to chat / Remove from chat / Queued toggle; reset a comment to pending when its chip is removed; store commentId with the sent message.

diff.edit-in-viewer.why: There is no editor in the diff tab and no file-write command. The reference copy 'Edit in diff viewer' appears nowhere in src. Re-read at 1e73a260: Moved missing -> partial (#362). In the Entire file layout the open file becomes a Pierre Editor (FileDiffView.tsx:114-117, :191; EditInViewer.ts:18) with per-worktree drafts that remount on disk changes (EditInViewer.ts:35-76). Cmd+S (editor.saveFile, registry.ts:172) calls the registered diff_write_file (lib.rs:363), which writes via temp file + rename, keeps permissions, and refuses symlinks and paths resolving outside the worktree (write_file.rs:24-74); the diff then reloads quietly. Unsaved dot and 'Failed to save file' error shown (FileDiffView.tsx:245, :250). Missing: editing in unified/split, persisted drafts, moving comments with edited lines, a 'Failed to open editor' boundary. Bugs: in a turn view the editor starts from the turn's end checkpoint (git.rs:34) and Cmd+S writes it over newer changes; unsaved edits are dropped when the file changes on disk (EditInViewer.ts:69-74), while Conductor remounts only with no draft pending; reloadQuietly can overwrite a newer load.
diff.edit-in-viewer.obligation: Disable editing (or start from the worktree file) while a turn is selected; keep unsaved drafts when the file changes on disk; persist drafts; move comments with edited lines; support editing in unified/split; add the 'Failed to open editor' boundary; guard reloadQuietly against stale responses.

pr.archive-on-merge.why: Unchanged: onLookup (WorkspaceView.tsx) archives only the open workspace through db_archive_workspace, which only flips the row's state. pr_sync_workspace now writes derived_status 'done' on merge but does not archive. Missing: watch every workspace, per-repo override, toast Open PR/Unarchive, full archive (archive_commit + worktree cleanup), stacked-PR exception. Re-read at a0139339: Gap smaller (#366): useArchiveOnMergeWatcher (useArchiveOnMerge.ts:94-139, App.tsx:66) polls pr_lookup every 60 s for every non-archived workspace; per-repo override via repo_archive_on_merge (lib.rs:345); the toast offers Open PR and Unarchive (db_unarchive_workspace, lib.rs:344). Still missing: full archive (archive_commit, worktree removal); the archive write is fire-and-forget (store.ts:351-355) so the success toast shows even on failure; only the main chat counts as a running agent (useArchiveOnMerge.ts:126); no merge/rebase busy check; no stack exception. Re-read at 1e73a260: No change; #387/#362 touched no PR file (WorkspaceView.tsx additions are in ChatPanel). Last pass's bugs remain: 'archived' toast before db_archive_workspace is awaited (store.ts:351-354, useArchiveOnMerge.ts:52-60); only the main chat counts as a running agent (useArchiveOnMerge.ts:126, WorkspaceView.tsx:105-107); no merge/rebase check (busy_state only in workspace/mod.rs). New minor: Unarchive restores the workspace object captured before archiving (useArchiveOnMerge.ts:56). Re-read at 145d9593: Gap smaller (#391): every archive, including archive on merge, now goes through store.ts startArchive -> the registered archive_workspace (flow.rs): checkpoint, archive_commit, archive script, worktree removal, optional branch deletion; the toast's Unarchive runs unarchive_workspace (worktree re-added, uncommitted work restored, setup rerun). A merge or rebase in progress now refuses the archive (mod.rs:229-231, WorkspaceArchiveBlockedByGitOperationError) and failures show as sticky toasts (App.tsx:75-90). Still wrong: archiveAfterMerge (useArchiveOnMerge.ts:51-58) shows 'PR #N merged and workspace archived' right after dispatch, before archive_workspace resolves, so a refused or failed archive shows both the success toast and the error; Conductor's mGe awaits e.workspace.archiveWorkspace before toastSuccess (index-BGEQ8YjU.js @669,286, read on Sven's Mac). Only the main chat counts as a running agent. No stacked-PR exception ('Workspace kept for the rest of the stack', same offset). Re-read at 99edc403: unchanged; #423 only registers recent_local_repositories (sidebar) in lib.rs. Re-read at f6c05d78: Unchanged verdict. #397 changed the store archive path archive-on-merge dispatches into (store.ts:368-373): it now refuses over any working chat of the workspace including review chats (archive.ts:26-28, archiveModel.ts blockedByAgents) and stops the workspace's Reason chats first. archiveAfterMerge still decides with its own main-chat-only check (useArchiveOnMerge.ts:126; WorkspaceView.tsx:132-136,:763) and still toasts 'PR #N merged and workspace archived' before archive_workspace resolves (useArchiveOnMerge.ts:52-57), so with only a review chat running the user sees the success toast and the agents-running dialog for an archive that never happened; Conductor awaits the archive. No stacked-PR exception. A running Codex chat is invisible to workspaceAgentStatus/stopWorkspaceAgents (codexChat.ts never publishes to chatStatuses), so archiving a non-open workspace removes the worktree under a live Codex turn and codex_close_chat is never called.
pr.archive-on-merge.obligation: Await archive_workspace before any toast and show only the failure or agents-running outcome when it doesn't archive; have archiveAfterMerge use workspaceAgentStatus, with Codex chats published to it and closed on archive; add the stacked-PR exception.

pr.workspace-from-pr.why: App.tsx mounts CreateWorkspaceDialog, whose CreateFromPicker has a 'Pull requests' tab filled by the registered pr_list_open (bundled gh, list.rs), and gh_issue_list_open fills the Issues tab. Choosing a PR sends existingBranch and prNumber to create_workspace, which fetches pull/<n>/head for forks. Search only filters the first 100 open PRs on the client (createFrom.ts `matches`). A pasted PR outside that list gives 'Could not load that pull request', because NOTES confirms the reference's server-side search/issues and pulls/{n} lookup were not built.
pr.workspace-from-pr.obligation: Add search-as-you-type over all PRs (gh search prs or search/issues) and by-number or URL lookup (gh pr view), then create the workspace from the result and link it to the PR.
